answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, within each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial whose secret coefficient is bound to their Semaphore/RLN identity. Each rate-limited message carries a zero-knowledge proof and polynomial share; duplicate messages under the same epoch and limit expose sufficient points for Shamir interpolation to recover the private key. The verifier proves the collision and instantly slashes collateral, while copper, cedar, and velvet serve as independent domain labels.
